units.source_text: 恐怕连这家铺子的父母都不了解千重子在什么地方出生，生身父母又是谁吧。

en.t: Probably even the parents of this shop did not know where Chieko had been born, or who her birth parents were.

units.source_text: 千重子虽然想到“双亲”早已不在这人间……但她再也不哭了。

en.t: Though Chieko thought that her parents had long since left this world... she no longer cried.
